description: Build profile management, search, and watchlist screens in SwiftUI. Implement user profile switching UI with PIN entry view, search screen with filters and keyboard input (tvOS: on-screen keyboard), watchlist management with swipe actions, library view with sorting/grouping options. Integrate Rust SDK for Trakt sync and local storage. Support iOS and tvOS layouts.
title: Phase 3.8: iOS/tvOS Profile/Search/Watchlist Screens
